insights.title: ₹9.8L Free-Rider Waste in Snacks & Grocery
insights.description: Eid Essentials Offer and Oil BOGO have 58% and 57% free-rider ratios respectively, wasting ₹6L combined this week. Loyal buyers are stockpiling without switching brands.
insights.action: Immediately gate Eid Essentials to new-to-brand/lapsed segments only. Replace Oil BOGO with bundle mechanic (Saffola + spice combo). Combined recovery potential: ₹6L this week.

insights.title: Cashback Outperforms Bundle by 2.6× in ROI
insights.description: Loyalty Gold Cashback (Personal Care) delivers 3.7× ROI with 31% free-rider ratio vs Weekend Snack Bundle's 1.4× ROI with 62% free-riders. Cashback drives ₹2.1L incremental revenue vs ₹246K.
insights.action: Shift Q2 Snacks & Biscuits budget from bundle to cashback mechanic. Model Loyalty Gold structure for Chips & Namkeen to target 3×+ ROI and reduce free-rider waste.

insights.title: ₹6.2L Lost to Cost Passthrough Gaps
insights.description: India Gate Basmati 5kg margin eroded to 12.0% after 8% cost increase with no shelf price update. Across portfolio, ₹6.2L margin leakage from delayed cost passthroughs this week.
insights.action: Implement weekly automated cost-to-shelf price reconciliation. Raise India Gate Basmati by ₹30 immediately. Flag all SKUs with >5% cost increases in past 30 days for urgent pricing review.

insights.title: ₹4L Markdown Risk Despite 70% Sell-Through
insights.description: Sell-through at 69.83% is 5.17 points below target, creating ₹3.99L markdown exposure. ₹340K already lost this week to premature markdowns triggered by velocity gaps.
insights.action: Audit all SKUs at <65% sell-through with >14 days shelf life. Deploy tactical flash promos (4-hour windows) on high-margin slow movers before resorting to markdown. Target 75% sell-through by week-end.
